text: Add now has an Other choice for tokens, medals and other collectibles, and the photo reader names them.
You can now keep other pieces such as tokens and medals in your Collection, with a name like "Subway token", and find them again with a new Other filter and search.
The key on Unlock shows zeros with a slash, so a 0 is never read as an o.
Add a pile of coins fast: photograph front and back, Name it, and go straight on; each fills itself in as Legend names it.
Unlock shows this phone's key as a QR code for Dad's Postern to scan.
Wish list: keep a coin you saw at the store with its price, save up for it, and move it into your collection with 'Got it!'.
Unlock answers in a few seconds, not tens of seconds, on a phone that has no licence yet.
Ask the tutor about any of your coins or a country, and it answers from that coin; it can suggest a setting, which changes only if you tap Apply.
Legend now gives each coin a rough worth, clearly marked as an estimate, and shows a rough worth for your whole collection and, in the store, for a coin you are only looking at.
Photograph a coin or a banknote front and back and Legend names it for you to check, or just look at coins without adding them.
You can tell the maker what you would like added or what is wrong, from the small "…" on each screen or from Settings, and the Globe now shows a one-time tip.
Learn now teaches grading, mint marks and special years using the coins you have, and Your path shows what you have learned and what to try next.
You can now share a picture of your globe or a card of one coin or note from the Share button, and only that picture leaves the phone.
Legend now opens on an Unlock screen until Dad has issued this phone a licence.

The Collection now shows everything you've collected as a photo grid or list, with search, filters for coins, bills and countries, and a page for each item with its photos, facts, notes, edit and remove.
The Quarters screen shows a map of the United States lit with the quarters you have, a checklist of every quarter, and what you are still missing for each state.

The Globe: turn it with a finger to see the countries your coins come from lit in gold, tap a country to see your coins from there and the money it uses now and used before, and see which countries you have nothing from yet.
Legend now has a bottom bar with Collection, Globe, Quarters, Learn and Settings, and a Settings screen where you can change the theme, the text size and more.
Legend is here: it opens on your phone as an app, and tells you which version you have.
